group: Valid input, validation enabled, default execution context

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors
cases.description: A well‑formed JSON document that conforms to the schema should walk the tree, perform validation and return a successful ValidationResult.

group: Valid input, validation disabled, default execution context

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors (validation flag ignored)
cases.description: When the validate flag is false the walk method should still parse the input and return a successful result without performing schema validation.

group: Invalid JSON input – deserialization failure

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains a parsing error
cases.description: Malformed JSON should cause the internal deserialize method to throw an exception; walk must catch it and return a ValidationResult indicating failure.

group: Null input string – argument validation

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or ValidationResult.success == false with a null‑input error message)
cases.description: Passing a null input should be rejected early, either by throwing NPE or by returning a failed ValidationResult.

group: Unsupported input format – branch for format handling

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage mentions unsupported format
cases.description: If the supplied InputFormat is not supported by the deserialize method, walk should return a failure result indicating the problem.

group: Non‑null ExecutionContextCustomizer – customizer invoked

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and the ExecutionContext used during walk contains attribute "custom" = true
cases.description: When a custom ExecutionContextCustomizer is supplied it must be invoked; the test verifies that the customizer mutates the context as expected.

group: ExecutionContextCustomizer throws exception – error propagation

cases.expected: RuntimeException propagated (or ValidationResult.success == false with a customizer error message)
cases.description: If the customizer throws an exception, walk should not swallow it silently; the test confirms that the exception bubbles up or is reported in the result.

group: Valid input with required property missing – validation enabled

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains a 'required' error for property 'name'
cases.description: The JSON document does not contain the required property 'name'. Walk should parse the document, run validation and return a failure result with the appropriate required‑property message.

group: Valid JSON array input against object schema – validation error

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage mentions type mismatch (expected object, found array)
cases.description: The schema expects an object at the root, but the input is a JSON array. Walk must detect the type mismatch and report it.

group: Valid YAML input – validation enabled

input.value:
type: object
properties:
  id:
    type: integer

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors
cases.description: When the library supports YAML, a well‑formed YAML schema should be deserialized, validated and return a successful result.

group: Recursive schema anchor – validation succeeds without stack overflow

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors (walk terminates correctly)
cases.description: The schema contains a recursive anchor referencing itself. Walk must handle the recursion guard and finish without infinite recursion.

group: Schema with $ref to external definition – reference resolved

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors
cases.description: The schema uses a $ref to an internal definition. Walk must resolve the reference and validate successfully.

group: ExecutionContextCustomizer disables format validation

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and no ValidationMessage errors (format validator disabled)
cases.description: The customizer turns off format validation. Even though the instance contains an invalid email format, walk should succeed because the format check is disabled.

group: Validate flag false but customizer throws exception – exception propagates

cases.expected: RuntimeException with message 'customizer failure' is thrown
cases.description: Even when validation is disabled, the supplied ExecutionContextCustomizer must be invoked. An exception thrown by the customizer should propagate out of walk.

group: Empty string input – deserialization failure

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains a parsing error indicating empty input
cases.description: An empty string is not valid JSON. Walk should catch the deserialization error and return a failed ValidationResult.

group: Null InputFormat – argument validation

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) thrown because inputFormat is null
cases.description: The walk method must reject a null InputFormat before attempting deserialization.

group: ExecutionContextCustomizer throws AssertionError – error propagation

input.value: ctx -> { throw new AssertionError("customizer assertion failure"); }

cases.expected: AssertionError with message 'customizer assertion failure' propagates out of walk
cases.description: Even though the exception is an Error (not a RuntimeException), walk must not catch it and should let it bubble up.

group: Deep recursive schema without $recursiveAnchor – stack overflow protection

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage mentions recursion depth limit or StackOverflowError is avoided
cases.description: A schema that references each other without a $recursiveAnchor should be detected as too deep; the implementation must guard against infinite recursion and return a failure result rather than crashing.

group: Invalid percent‑encoding in input – UnsupportedEncodingException handling

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains a decoding error (UnsupportedEncodingException)
cases.description: When the input format expects URL‑encoded data, malformed percent‑encoding should trigger an UnsupportedEncodingException which must be reported as a parsing failure.

group: Unsupported enum constant for InputFormat – illegal argument handling

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown indicating that the supplied InputFormat is not supported
cases.description: If a caller passes an InputFormat value that the deserialize method does not handle (e.g., CSV), walk must reject it with an appropriate exception.
